explanation: P means punch and K means kick. LP, MP, HP and LK, MK, HK represent light, medium and heavy strengths.
Number-pad directions assume the character faces right: 2 = down, 3 = down-forward, 6 = forward. 236P is quarter-circle forward plus punch.
6 = forward, 2 = down, 3 = down-forward. 623P is commonly called a dragon-punch motion.
2 = down, 1 = down-back, 4 = back. 214K means quarter-circle back plus kick.
Hold back (4) for a charge, then press forward (6) and punch. Exact charge duration depends on the move.
A powerful armored attack activated with Heavy Punch + Heavy Kick in Classic controls. It consumes Drive Gauge.
Hold Medium Punch + Medium Kick in Classic controls to enter a defensive parry state, consuming Drive Gauge.
A fast advancing action using Drive Gauge. It can be performed from a parry or by canceling eligible attacks.
Press two punches or two kicks for an eligible special move to use its Overdrive version, consuming Drive Gauge.
Classic uses six attack buttons and traditional inputs; Modern uses simplified special-move inputs; Dynamic is designed for casual offline play.
